title: Elytra Regear
description: Simple client-sided mod that automaticly equips a new Elytra from your inventory when your current one breaks mid-flight with a lot of customizability
body:
![title](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/98f526c1f66d75d2255f57b8c8e28bbd7819330f.png)
A clean, customizable client-side mod that automatically equips a new Elytra from your inventory when your current one breaks mid-flight. Built to prevent a cummon avoidable death


## ⚡ Features
> **🪽 Automatic Elytra Regear**
- Instantly swaps in a new Elytra when your equipped one breaks
- Keeps you moving without double pressing jump again
- Only swaps while gliding


> **⚙️ Customizable Settings**
- Toggle the mod on or off at any time
- Option to enable or disable it on multiplayer servers
- Option to ignore Curse of Binding Elytras

> **⌨️ Built-in Keybind**
- Open the settings menu with a keybind
- Fully changeable in Minecraft controls
 

## ⚙️ Technical Details
- Built for Fabric
- Lightweight and simple
- Client-side only

## ⚠️ Disclaimer
Using this mod on multiplayer servers could result in getting kicked or banned. \
We DO NOT recomment using the mod on public servers without asking staff for permission. \
We are not responsible for any punishment you receive by using this mod.
